description: CONSTRUCTED reference cases for the Sprint 2 detection rule (not real observations). History is generated every 5 days through the baseline year as level + amplitude * sin(2*pi*(day_of_year - 80)/365) + a fixed +/-noise pattern. 'latest' lists the newest observations in the target year, oldest first.

cases.name: stable_site
cases.why: Latest values are normal for the season

cases.name: single_outlier
cases.why: One low value (e.g. haze) is not a sustained decline

cases.name: recovering
cases.why: Two low values followed by a normal one

cases.name: seasonal_low_is_normal
cases.why: A strong seasonal low that matches last year's same season

cases.name: small_drop_on_very_stable_site
cases.why: z <= -2 because the site is very stable, but the drop is under 0.05

cases.name: no_previous_year
cases.why: Baseline not available without an earlier year

cases.name: sparse_history
cases.why: Fewer than 8 observations in the seasonal window

cases.name: january_drop_window_wraps
cases.why: January baseline uses December, January and February

cases.name: native_low_ndvi_stable
cases.why: Low greenness that is normal for drought-adapted planting

cases.name: native_low_ndvi_drop
cases.why: A decline relative to the site's own low level

cases.name: only_two_new_observations
cases.why: The third-latest observation is from the baseline year itself
